bands.A: at least three certified peers (within 25% of n, within 2 of d) with a median side time under 600 s
bands.B: a certified peer under 3,600 s, or n <= 400 and d <= 16 (the region the October 2026 Perlmutter run closed at 2,400 s per solve)
bands.C: n <= 700 and d <= 24: beyond any certified peer, inside what the SAT tier has reached (largest certified d is 19)
bands.D: n > 700 or d > 24: nothing certified on main resembles it
bands.P: stabilizer code: certified in Pauli weight only by the sweep's tropidist backend (solver level)

caveat: every d here is a witnessed upper bound until a certificate says otherwise; the band is an estimate from other entries' certificates on other machines, not a promise

rule: records first (on a cell frontier or the global one), then band A to D (P last), then cheapest first by the peers' median side seconds and then by n, then slug; regenerated from codes/ and certs/, so an honored certificate removes an entry and a changed distance re-lists it at the new value
